name: Rust license platform (Axum + React)
description: Containerized licensing API in Rust with React frontend, MongoDB, JWT sessions, machine verification, and OpenAPI for integrators.
longDescription: A licensing service designed for container deployment: Rust API with OpenAPI documentation, MongoDB persistence, and a React SPA for user flows. Browser users manage licenses through authenticated sessions; machine clients use signed request headers with separate trust rules. Compose stacks split development and production; health and version endpoints support orchestration. Automated test runners cover frontend and backend. Environment verification scripts keep deployment configuration consistent.
features: Memory-safe Rust service layer around crypto and persistence
Registration, email verification, login, and session management
License issue and verify flows with machine attestation
Operator diagnostics, settings, and metrics hooks
Automated frontend and backend test suites
role: Backend API design and frontend integration
highlights: Clear separation between browser sessions and machine API verification
OpenAPI as the integration contract with container-first operations
Reproducible compose profiles for dev and production
challenges: Human browsers and headless clients multiply authentication and replay edge cases.
solutions: Documented signed verification, production-only secrets, and OpenAPI as the stable integration surface.
security: JWT signing secrets required in production
Separate machine signing secret from browser session tokens
Configurable license digest pepper per environment
Timestamped signatures to limit replay within documented windows
Secrets only via environment configuration, never in source control
